description: Strictly return ONLY ONE of two states: 1) If an error occurs or identification fails, return ONLY the 'errmsg' object, and omit successful fields. 2) If successful, return data fields and completely omit 'errmsg'.

errmsg.description: Error information returned when facial skin analysis fails or invalid image/system error occurs. Omit this entirely if analysis is successful.

errorCode.description: Specific error code classifying the scan failure or system error.

suggestion.description: Suggested action or explanation for resolving the error.

data.description: Facial skin assessment details. Omit this entirely if an error occurs.

skinTone.description: Classified skin color scale based on cheek and forehead area.

skinAge.description: Estimated skin age range as a string, e.g. '25-30'.

hydration.description: Hydration status based on surface texture, shine, or dryness.

skinType.description: Skin type classification based on T-zone, pores, and oil shine.
